anomalies.description: A silver hatchback collides with a motorcycle at an intersection, causing the motorcycle to be thrown and its rider to be ejected onto the road.

A motorcycle is seen lying on its side on the road, indicating a recent collision; a silver hatchback is stopped nearby with visible damage to its front right side, and two individuals are running away from the scene.
After the crash, two individuals engage in a physical altercation near the wreckage; one appears to strike or push the other while both are standing.

One individual appears to strike or push another who is near or on the ground beside the fallen motorcycle; the second person is in a vulnerable posture, suggesting helplessness during the interaction.
A silver hatchback is stopped with its driver-side door open; a scooter lies on its side on the road nearby, indicating a recent collision between the car and the scooter.
A dark sedan on the left side of the road suddenly swerves sharply to the right, collides with the rear of a white SUV ahead, and then rolls over onto its roof, coming to rest on the road surface.

A red train collides with a dark SUV on a road crossing, causing a violent impact and immediate dust/debris cloud that obscures the scene.; Interior view after the collision: vehicle interior is filled with smoke/dust; occupants visible but disoriented; one person appears to be holding a phone or device amid chaos.
